additional_info.subject: RE: ID0477039-DC/Si-UC/CZ-[Y2 / S6 313724839005] OCPP connection issue CRM:02889001072
additional_info.body:
Dear Milan,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0477039
for charger
Y2/S6 313724839005
at
EDRI.
Today I checked the charger, and the OCPP connection was offline. Therefore:
I connected via SSH to the charger and verified that router 2 was reachable
I tried to login to the router in the webUI, but the password was not recognized. I tried also with admin or admin01, but all passwords were recognized wrong.
I rebooted the router, and after that the router has the webUI blocked. I tried to login in the root of the router via ssh, but again all passwords are wrong.
To proceed further and solve the issue, it is necessary to go onsite and:
Verify if it is possible to login locally with the password, or if the correct password is the one printed on the router itself.
If the login is successful, check inside the router if any IP of the charger is blocked. That would explain why the webUI is not reachable anymore
If not, try to reset the router via Companion Tool
If also this is not possible, replace the router and reconfigure it. Therefore, please bring a spare router onsite, and some eth cables as well.
As I will not be able to further support this ticket in the next days, I am handing over the ticket to my colleague Francisco. He's already informed and aware of the issue.
Looking forward to hearing form you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
